product-research.description.zh-CN: 独立于单次投资持续运行，沉淀可复用、可追溯的产品研究结论与产品池。
product-research.description.en-US: Continuous product research with reusable, traceable conclusions and product pools.

pre-investment.description.zh-CN: 针对单个组合，自上而下完成目标定义、大类配置、产品配置研究、方案定稿与外部审批结果记录。
pre-investment.description.en-US: Define objectives, research asset and product allocation, finalize proposals and record external approvals.

portfolio-center.description.zh-CN: 统一登记真实组合及其研究方案、账户、核算主体、账簿和生命周期关系，是投中、基金会计与投后的共同主数据入口。
portfolio-center.description.en-US: Maintain portfolios, proposals, accounts, accounting entities, books and lifecycle relationships in a shared master-data hub.

investment-execution.description.zh-CN: 基于组合中心登记的真实组合，完成方案落地、交易计划测算、执行结果衔接、资金核对和再平衡研究；不提供下单能力。
investment-execution.description.en-US: Support implementation, trade planning, execution records, cash reconciliation and rebalancing research. No order placement is provided.

fund-accounting.description.zh-CN: 与投资决策线并行并贯穿投中、投后，把业务事实转换为各核算主体独立平衡的复式凭证、账簿、估值、报表与绩效数据；当前仅为研究平台静态框架。
fund-accounting.description.en-US: Translate business facts into balanced entries, ledgers, valuations, statements and performance data for each entity. Currently a static research-platform framework.

post-investment.description.zh-CN: 基于会计核算形成的实际组合事实，解释投资结果、识别收益与风险来源并形成可审计的研究结论。
post-investment.description.en-US: Explain realized results, identify return and risk sources, and record auditable conclusions using accounting facts.

feedback.description.zh-CN: 把实际投资结果反馈给产品研究、配置模型和投资流程，形成可审计的持续改进。
feedback.description.en-US: Feed realized results back into product research, allocation models and investment processes.

portfolio-solutions.description.zh-CN: 承接已定稿的组合研究版本，形成面向产品、渠道与客户的标准化组合展示；不参与单个组合的研究决策闭环。
portfolio-solutions.description.en-US: Present finalized portfolio research to products, distribution channels and clients, independently of portfolio decision workflows.

settings.description.zh-CN: 统一管理数据、研究口径、指标、情景算法、回测、规则版本和公共参数，不进入单个组合的投资主流程。
settings.description.en-US: Manage shared data, research conventions, indicators, scenario algorithms, backtests, versioned rules, language and parameters.

product-research.pool-lifecycle.zh-CN: 产品池版本与生命周期管理

pre-investment.portfolio-synthesis.zh-CN: 目标组合合成与风险检查
pre-investment.portfolio-synthesis.en-US: Target portfolio synthesis and risk checks

pre-investment.validation.zh-CN: 统一回测与稳健性验证

pre-investment.approval.zh-CN: 研究方案定稿与外部审批记录

pre-investment.saa.allocation-lab.zh-CN: 大类资产配置与策略回测

investment-execution.trade-plan.zh-CN: 目标组合与交易计划测算

investment-execution.trade-allocation.zh-CN: 汇总订单与公平交易分配

fund-accounting.policy.zh-CN: 核算主体、账簿与记账规则

fund-accounting.account-statements.zh-CN: 外部账户流水、拆分与结算匹配
fund-accounting.account-statements.en-US: Account statements, allocation and settlement matching

fund-accounting.booking.zh-CN: 组合 Booking 与复式记账

fund-accounting.portfolio-ledger.zh-CN: 组合/基金总账与明细账

fund-accounting.valuation-nav.zh-CN: 估值、应计与净资产核算

post-investment.portfolio-data.zh-CN: 实际组合数据与三账核对

post-investment.monitoring.zh-CN: 持仓产品与管理人监控

feedback.product-review.zh-CN: 产品复审与产品池更新

settings.language-terminology.descriptio.zh-CN: 查看内置系统翻译，维护独立的业务术语与多语言覆盖。
settings.language-terminology.descriptio.en-US: View read-only system translations and manage separate multilingual business terminology.
